In twenty twenty one, Ravi had one lakh rupees, and he could pick just one stock. Five years later, one choice turned it into crores. Another lost him money. Here are ten real stocks.
Starting at number ten. Hitachi Energy turned that one lakh into almost sixteen lakh. Servotech, twenty five lakh. GE Vernova, almost thirty lakh. And AXISCADES, thirty one lakh.
Kesar India, forty nine lakh. BSE, the stock exchange itself, fifty seven lakh. And Spectrum Electrical, eighty nine lakh. So close to a crore.
Number two. Nurture Well, a small biscuit maker. Ravi buys at just fourteen paise. Today, his one lakh is one crore twenty eight lakh.
But wait. In April, the same shares were worth two and a half crore. Half of it is already gone.
Number one. Cupid. Two rupees forty five paise in July twenty twenty one. Today, three hundred sixty five rupees. One lakh became one crore forty nine lakh.
Now the twist. The biggest IPO of twenty twenty one was Pay T M, at two thousand one hundred fifty rupees. That one lakh is worth about eighty one thousand today.
So only two of these ten made crores. And lists like this never show the stocks that crashed. You only hear about the winners.
Don't bet everything on one stock. Spread it out, check the business, and be patient. Save this, and follow money in cloud. Not a buy or sell call.
